_about: A plot frame converted from the title block file frame.tbf by tools/title_frame_from_tbf.py: every line, text and symbol of the file, nothing added and nothing left out. Coordinates are millimetres on the paper, the origin at its bottom-left and Y up; anchor_tbf includes each text's offset and raise. See docs/plotting.md.

coordinates.tbf_origin: bottom-left of the sheet, Y up
coordinates.text_anchor: a text is drawn at (x + offset, y + raise); anchor_tbf already includes it
coordinates.arcs: an arc of the file (radius_data) is drawn as straight pieces within 0.005 mm of it; the entity keeps the file's radii in "arcs"

text_rules.size: cap_height_mm is the capital's height; em_size_mm = cap_height_mm / 0.716, Arial's cap height
text_rules.multiline: anchored on the FIRST line and grows downward whatever the justification; line pitch is 1.5 x cap height
